name: GitHub
description: Pull requests waiting for your review or for you, Actions runs, assigned issues and notifications

fields.label: Refresh every
fields.help: How often everything is fetched from GitHub.

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: Extra GitHub search qualifiers for pull requests and issues, such as org:acme or repo:acme/api. Empty: every repository.

fields.label: Show
fields.help: What the tile and its popup show.

fields.label: Watch Actions in
fields.help: Repositories (owner/name, comma-separated, up to 10) whose workflow runs you see from anyone. Runs you start show from repositories with your open pull requests anyway.
